properties.description:
THE OAUTH 2.1 FLOOR (req:every-oauth-role-reflow2-plays-meets-oauth-2-1-at-a-minimum, "WHAT THE FLOOR INCLUDES", resource-server items), each pinned by a test in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/an_exposed_server_verifies_bearer_tokens.rs:
- Bearer tokens in the Authorization header only, NEVER a URI query string: a_token_in_the_query_string_is_refused_and_never_used (400 invalid_request, alone or beside a valid header, and the call wrote nothing); a_malformed_authorization_header_is_an_invalid_request.
- Every token validated — signature: a_valid_token_makes_the_call_the_mapped_contributors (RS256, ES256, EdDSA really signed), a_token_from_the_wrong_issuer_audience_or_time_is_invalid (an unpublished key, a signature that does not verify), alg_none_and_hs256_are_refused (none, HS256 keyed with the public modulus, an alg that does not fit its key); issuer, audience restricted to THIS resource (RFC 8707; none and another resource's both refused), expiry (expired, absent) and nbf: a_token_from_the_wrong_issuer_audience_or_time_is_invalid.
- Failures answer with WWW-Authenticate and the right status: 400 invalid_request, 401 invalid_token, 403 insufficient_scope (a_token_without_the_required_scope_or_claim_is_insufficient_scope), and 401 with no error code and resource_metadata when there is no token (a_request_with_no_token_is_challenged_with_the_resource_metadata).
- No token passed through to another service: the Authorization header is removed at the gate before any tool runs (bearer.rs unit test the_token_is_never_passed_through); reflow2 forwards no request anywhere.
- Protected resource metadata (RFC 9728): the_protected_resource_metadata_is_served.
- TLS stated, never assumed: tls_is_stated_and_a_cleartext_public_url_is_refused (--help and the startup banner say reflow2 does not terminate TLS; a non-loopback http:// public URL is refused).
- Local use unchanged, no OAuth: loopback_http_without_an_issuer_takes_no_token; the_issuer_is_refused_where_a_token_cannot_arrive_or_beside_a_gateway (stdio, --shared, and beside --http-trusted-gateway). The trusted-gateway path is pinned unchanged by a_signature_is_the_callers_own_through_every_writer.rs (#636), still passing.
ALSO PINNED: the contributor comes from the operator's mapping and is never invented (a_contributor_the_design_does_not_hold_is_refused_and_never_invented, an_operator_map_names_the_contributor); a rotated key is fetched by kid, once (an_unknown_key_id_refreshes_the_key_set); a pinned key set needs no network (a_pinned_key_set_needs_no_network); a session belongs to the sign-in that opened it (a_session_is_bound_to_the_sign_in_that_opened_it — the MCP authorization spec's session binding; the session never authenticates); a server that waited out a held lock (#620) verifies every token on the degraded surface and after recovery, and the recovered design is held to the bearer caller rule through ServeAs::prepare (a_recovered_resource_server_still_verifies_every_token, shown to go red when the recovered door is built without the verifier).
NOT IN THIS FLOOR (the CLIENT role, LATER per the requirement): PKCE, exact redirect URIs, refresh-token rotation — reflow2's --remote client still owes a sign-in flow.

PASSING on the branch (PR #643): GitHub Actions ran cargo test --workspace green on 388a284. Locally on 24f4758 (merged with main at 1869f4d), in this worktree own target dir under the shared build lock, the 17 tests in this file passed, with the reflow2-mcp lib tests (182, the bearer:: and caller:: units among them), a_signature_is_the_callers_own_through_every_writer (#636 trusted-gateway path, unchanged), no_per_design_process_globals, no_served_text_writes_a_readers_persona_into_the_design, a_degraded_server_recovers_when_its_cause_clears, a_refused_host_is_told_which_flag_admits_it, a_session_names_who_it_writes_for and a_local_client_works_against_a_remote_server.
properties.findings: OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on origin/main dd9626d (2026-10-01, own target dir, shared build lock; the test file and fixture untracked in a detached worktree, with ring and base64 added as dev-dependencies only so it could compile): 15 of the 16 tests then in the file failed (log: bearer-failfirst.log in the session scratchpad). 13 failed because the server would not start: "error: unexpected argument --http-public-url found" — main had no resource-server mode. The startup-refusal test failed because --http-oidc-issuer was an unknown flag rather than refused with a reason; the TLS test failed because --help said nothing about TLS. The 16th, loopback_http_without_an_issuer_takes_no_token, passed on main as it must: it pins behaviour that does not change. The 17th, a_recovered_resource_server_still_verifies_every_token, was written after #620 merged; it was shown red by a mutation run (the recovered door built without the verifier) and green on the true source.
properties.name: An exposed server verifies bearer tokens to the OAuth 2.1 resource-server floor, and the caller is the Contributor the operator's mapping derives
